title: DocMaster category entry
description: One category of AI PDF (service pdf, feature ai.pdf_topic) or AI Slides (service slides, feature ai.pptx): apps/studio/categories/data/<id>.json. A PDF template is a separate document validated against #/$defs/template: apps/studio/categories/data/templates/<template id>.json. Everything a customer reads carries uz, ru and en; everything the model reads is English. Group buttons (pdf.biz, pdf.xat, slides.tadbir) and the Boshqa buttons are not categories: they live in data/index.json. Validated at import by jsonschema (a runtime dependency already, through drf-spectacular) and then by the cross-reference checks of catalogue.py. Ids are append-only: a field id or part id in data/ids.lock.json may be marked retired but never removed or reused with another kind.

id.description: Stored as options.category, in Quote.parameters.category and in analytics. Never renamed and never deleted: retire it instead.

status.description: draft: converted, not yet reviewed. ready: passed the catalogue checks at its budgets, its samples were looked at and its native review was signed (package N1/N2); only a ready entry can be ticked live in the admin. retired: kept so drafts made with it still generate; it cannot be created, listed or ticked.

parent.description: The group button this category sits under, or null for the first list.

summary.description: English, for staff; not sent to the model.

tone.description: English; opens the category's instruction block.

topic.description: true: today's topic question (domain.require_topic and the bot's topic loop, unchanged, answer joined in front) runs for this category. false for papers whose subject is the category itself (ariza, letters, business, events).

topic_prompt.description: Optional wording of the topic question for this category (Qaysi fan va qaysi mavzu bo‘yicha test kerak?); without it today's wording is shown.

title.description: What content.title (and so the file name) is. model: written from the customer's topic. label: this category's label without its emoji, for a paper with no title of its own (Ariza). Default model.

quality.description: repair: quality.finish may send flagged prose parts back to the model once; parts in finish.exempt are never flagged. fixed: tidy and alphabet only, nothing sent back (the CV's deterministic finish).

fill.description: pdf with length.target count only: whether filling.top_up may write the ungrounded elastic prose parts further when the paper renders short of its pages.

cues.description: Named stem lists matched, lower case, against language.normalised() of the message (apostrophes folded to '); a cue holds when any stem of any language is found. The name 'sources' is reserved and computed: it holds when files are attached or a references stem (adabiyot, manba, литератур, источник, reference, bibliograph) is in the message.

exclusive.description: Ordered lists of cues that exclude each other: when several of one list hold, only the first one found in list order counts (himoya: masters, bmi, kurs, internship).

ask.description: The one extra, skippable question, offered on the review screen as a button (never a blocking refusal), or null.

groups.description: pdf: parts that repeat together as one unit (a chapter with its subsections, an agenda item with its decisions). A group of one part is a repeated part.

templates.description: pdf: ids of data/templates/<id>.json, the default first; every other one carries a pick. Empty for slides.

take.description: head_tail: when the attached files hold more text than the plan's source wall, the first and last parts of each file are kept (a thesis's introduction and conclusion) instead of refusing; the review says so. Default all (today's refusal).

gates.description: What a person checks before the entry is marked ready (native readers, samples). English.

later.description: What the research spec asks for that this round does not build.

text3.description: Uzbek is Latin only, with ‘ (U+2018) in o‘ g‘ and ʼ (U+02BC) or ’ for the tutuq; no ASCII apostrophe; no < or &. Slots {field_id} are allowed in template labels; every language carries the same slots. The loader checks it.

label.description: A full-width bot button: one emoji, a space, the name; 32 characters at most. The uz name is the owner's wording exactly.

words.description: Lower-case stems that name the deferred thing; the catalogue test fails when any appears in the entry's bot prompt, examples, pool or notices, so no copy promises what is not built.

mode.description: count: options.pages, then a count in the brief, then by_cue, then default, clamped to min..max and the plan. fixed: always default, no stepper. derived: from the question count (per), no stepper.

target.description: count: the paper fills the number (word targets per part, a page rule that fills, top-up when fill). ceiling: the number is a maximum; parts get word maximums only, nothing pads the paper, no top-up, and the bot's shorter notice is shown when it renders shorter. Slides are always count.

per.description: derived only: pages = ceil((questions + first_page_fewer) / questions_per_page) + extra_pages.

when.description: When the review screen offers the button (asking.wanted, pure and cheap). cues_missing: no cue of the listed fields is found. few_words: fewer than threshold words. no_digits: no figure in the message and no file attached. always: on every new draft of the category.

review.description: The line on the review screen above the button: what will be blank if nothing is added.

prompt.description: The question shown after the button is tapped; the answer (text, files, or both) is added to the draft once.

cover.description: slides: the answer is added under a fixed title-slide header line (uz Titul slaydga:, ru На титульном слайде:, en Title slide:) that title_lines.BLOCK reads, so its lines are placed on the cover by title_lines.place.

kind.description: Decides how facts.supported holds a value to the customer's words and files (section 4 of the architecture). choice: one of the values listed in choices, not checked. flag: true or false. file: not written; the attached files.

choices.description: choice only: the closed values the model may return.

missing.description: ask: named by ask.fields; a ruled blank if still missing. blank: a ruled blank. omit: nothing is drawn. if_needed: the model returns ____ when this paper needs it and nothing when it does not.

clock.description: Filled by code from the Tashkent clock at finish time when the customer gave no value (the year on a title page, the date a letter is made). Never written by the model.

derived_from.description: A field id this one is made from (a signer's initials and surname from the full name); every word and initial must come from the verified base value.

where.description: English note for the template builder.

sized.description: length: the instance count follows the pages (by share). model: seeded at max; the model fills as many instances as the brief, its plan or its files need (a teacher's plan of three chapters fills three) and leaves the rest empty; finish drops empty instances, which quality never flags.

id.description: pdf: the section id of a written part; an instance of a grouped part is id_2, id_3 (the first keeps id). slides: the slot name; the slide's own id stays s1..sN.

kind.description: prose, list, table: one content section the model writes (body; items; one item per row). questions: drawn from content.questions, no section. fixed: drawn from facts and template labels, no section; its write is sent with the field table. sources: a list section the model writes, one item per source it can describe from the customer's words or files; code keeps only items that verify (section 4); never a file name. slide: one slide of a deck.

heading_mode.description: fixed: this entry's heading in the document's language, set by code at request and finish time. model: the model writes it (from the customer's plan when one is given). none: no heading.

need.description: required: always present. usual: present unless the count is too small. optional: only by when, from or join.

share.description: pdf: share of the pages, for word targets (target count) or word maximums (target ceiling) and call spans.

elastic.description: pdf: takes up the pages the other parts leave; the only parts a fit may trim or a top-up may extend (and only when not grounded).

group.description: pdf: the group (top-level groups) this part repeats with.

from.description: The smallest length (pages or slides) at which the part exists.

until.description: The largest length at which it exists.

join.description: slides: the order in which optional slots join as the count grows; repeating slots take the remainder.

repeat.description: slides only: a slot that repeats to fill the count.

when.description: Exists only when the cue holds (cue:) or does not (nocue:); cue:sources is the reserved computed cue.

write.description: English: what the model writes here. Sent as the part's row of the request's parts list; for a fixed part, sent with the field table for the fields it draws.

words.description: Lowest and highest word count when the part is not elastic.

columns.description: table: the header cells, drawn by code from here, never stored in the draft. A row is one item: label is the first cell, value the last, text the cells between joined by ' | '.

computed.description: table: cells the model leaves empty and derive.py fills from verified numbers of the same row (difference of plan and fact, percent, share of the column total, quantity times price).

total.description: table: columns summed by derive.py into a total row.

grounded.description: Every number, capitalised name, quotation and legal reference written here must be supported by the customer's words or files (facts.ground); what is not becomes an inline blank, or a removed sentence for a legal reference, and is counted.

block.description: pdf: the block of blocks.json that draws it by default.

layouts.description: slides: the layouts the slot may take, the preferred first; the last one any content fills (bullets, section, closing).

pins.description: slides: registered variants tried in order on the first render (render_pptx pins).

source.description: slides. template: fixed words. customer: only what the customer or the files say, grounded; with nothing, an honest blank form. draft: may be drafted from the topic's own words; the bot's draft notice says so.

checks.description: slides, a slot of source draft only: the customer's facts such a slot states about their own school or company, held as a grounded slot holds them (facts.guard with checks). numbers: every number, date, sum, e-mail and link must be the customer's; names: every run of capitalised words too. Quotations and legal references are checked on every draft slot; what is not supported becomes an inline blank and is counted.

notes.description: slides: the rule for the speaker notes of this slot.

retired.description: Kept for drafts made before; never seeded again.

to.description: model: sent in the category's instruction block. engine: kept by code (not sent). bot: about the chat. gate: a release check. rewrite: names a mechanism this design replaces; reworded or dropped before the entry is ready (a ready entry has none).

prompt.description: The body of the describe-what-you-need screen, under the bold service and category line.

pool.description: More examples, known to the our-own-example check in a category flow and used by the facts corpus test.

attach.description: Whether the prompt screen carries the files line.

blanks.description: Under the finished file when facts_blanked was raised.

draft.description: slides: under the file when a draft-source slot was drafted from the topic.

shorter.description: length.target ceiling: under the file when it rendered shorter than the number asked.

entries.description: The category ids that list this template.

pick.description: Taken instead of the default when this holds (cue:handout picks the tarqatma; locale:en picks the personal recommendation letter).

ladder.description: Body size and leading, loosest first.

uncounted.description: Each predicate that holds is one page the quote does not count (a lesson's cover, a handout's answer key): the body is held to the quote and that page follows it.

labels.description: Every fixed word the template prints; a label may hold {field_id} slots (a formula line), filled with the verified value or an inline blank.

mock.description: The research mock-up a sample is compared with.

block.description: An id of blocks.json with kind block.

part.description: A part of an entry that lists this template. Consecutive placements whose parts share a group are drawn once per instance, in order.

when.description: fact:id a verified value exists (fact:id=v: it equals v); nofact:id none (nofact:id=v: it is not v); blank:id a blank is drawn for it; part:id the part has text or items; nopart:id it has none; questions:choice|open|both|passage; cue:name / nocue:name; pages_from:N.

keep.description: Consecutive entries with one tag never separate across pages.

designs.description: Ids of deck_designs.DESIGNS. The first is the category's default look, written to template_style.deck_design of a new deck only, never to options.deck_design: a colour in the description and a pick on the setup screen still win.

variants.description: Per layout, the variants the research found calm; pinned for a slot that names no pins.

cover_lines.description: How many lines the cover slot asks the model for besides its title.
